parts.text: $BMRN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, +32% Y/Y, driven by a 44% increase in metabolic conditions following the Amicus acquisition. Operating margin -8.0%; operating cash flow $188M. #earnings #pharma

$CBT Q4 FY26 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, +12% Y/Y, driven by solid performance in Performance Chemicals despite lower gross profit in Reinforcement Materials. Operating margin 12.0%. #earnings #materials
$LDOS Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.6B, +4% Y/Y, driven by defense tech and intelligence mission support. Operating margin 11.9%; operating cash flow $523M. #earnings #tech

$DD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.9B, +4% Y/Y, driven by organic growth in healthcare and industrial markets. Operating margin 14.9%. Company guides to higher full-year organic growth. #earnings #materials

$MPC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $56.0B, +61% Y/Y, driven by higher market crack spreads across all regions. Operating margin reached 18.7% amid strong refining utilization and robust margin environments. #earnings #oil

$ET Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $37.1B, +86% Y/Y, driven by record intrastate transportation volumes. Net earnings were $1.2B, as the partnership raised its full-year Adjusted EBITDA range. #earnings #utilities
$ADM Earnings from Q3 2026: $22.3B of revenue, +10% Y/Y. Net earnings $821M on a 4.4% operating margin. Charts + what drove it? #earnings #consumer
$SYY Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $21.7B, +3% Y/Y, driven by local volume growth and expanding gross margins. Operating margin 3.3%; operating cash flow $278M. #earnings #industrials
$PFE Q3 2026: revenue $16.6B, flat Y/Y as COVID-19 declines were offset by growth in Eliquis and Padcev. Operating margin 20.4%; operating cash flow $5.4B. #earnings #pharma
$ETN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $8.9B, +28% Y/Y, driven by record orders across electrical segments. Operating margin 15.3%. #earnings #industrials
$KDP Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue rose to $7.3B, +71% Y/Y, driven by the JDE Peet's acquisition and refreshment growth. Operating margin 18.2%. #earnings #beverages
$FISV Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $5.2B, down 1% Y/Y, with an operating margin of -105.7% due to a goodwill impairment. The company affirms its 2026 outlook. #earnings #industrials
